findings.problem: In much of Latin America, especially Mexico, el clima is the everyday word for the weather, so a learner could answer el clima, and the hint's 'not the climate' doesn't rule that out because clima means weather there.
findings.fix: hint: the same word that also means time

back.es: el tiempo: time; weather (the state of the atmosphere)

note: Hace buen tiempo is understood everywhere, but many Latin American speakers would more naturally say hace buen clima, so the editor may want to mention el clima somewhere on the card.
